meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码提交与改动内容做成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 PR 里的改动讲给同事、用户或社区听,却不想自己录屏剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes on video but don't want to record and edit.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你指定的 GitHub PR（diff、提交、文件），规划并逐帧构建一个代码改动讲解视频，最终渲染出 renders/video.mp4。风格固定为 code-editorial，结尾带贡献者头像。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或在已检出仓库里说「this PR」时触发。它只处理代码改动，产品宣传片或无 PR 的话题讲解不走这里。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成讲解视频：acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 读取 diff 与提交，再规划分镜

say.text: 用「this PR」生成一段代码改动讲解视频
say.note: 在已检出仓库里读当前 PR

say.text: 讲讲这次修复到底改了什么
say.note: 按 fix-explainer 原型组织分镜

howto.what_en: Claude reads a GitHub PR you point it at (diff, commits, files) and builds a frame-by-frame code-change explainer video at renders/video.mp4. Style is fixed code-editorial.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. It only handles code changes; product promos or non-PR explainers use other skills.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Fetches the diff and commits, then plans the storyboard.

say_en.text: Use "this PR" to make a code-change explainer video
say_en.note: Reads the checked-out repo's current PR.

say_en.text: Walk through what this fix changed
say_en.note: Builds it on the fix-explainer archetype.
